observations.why: The speaker enacts a decision on behalf of the collective, performing authority to commit the group to a course of action.
The justification is framed entirely in proportional cost-benefit terms — performance multiplier and price reduction.
A ratified decision summary presented as settled fact; the footing has Xena as animator/author with Dave as principal, reporting Dave's authority to decide.
The gain is quantified as a proportional multiplier, the same cost-benefit proportionality as the source utterance, now reported through Xena's rendering of Dave's stance.
Xena as principal sets a deadline, enacting authority-ranking by unilaterally fixing the temporal commitment for the group.
